name_en: WQ101 Alpha45 Delayed Close / Volume Corr
name_zh: WQ101 Alpha45 滞后收盘量价相关
formula_zh: -rank(5期滞后收盘价20期均值)*corr(收盘价,成交量,2)*rank(corr(5期收盘和,20期收盘和,2))
intuition_en: Alpha formula from WQ101 paper, adapted for 25h bars.
intuition_zh: 源自WQ101论文的Alpha公式，适配25小时K线。
expected_direction_explanation_en: Direction intentionally left conditional to avoid post-hoc fitting. Empirical diagnostics required.
expected_direction_explanation_zh: 方向故意设为条件式以避免事后拟合。需实证诊断。
known_limitations_en: Mixes very short correlations with cross-sectional ranks; expected to be fragile and redundancy-prone.
known_limitations_zh: 混合极短相关和截面排名，预期较脆弱且可能高度冗余。
horizon_notes_en: Lookback window: 25 bars. Evaluation covers 1h/4h/24h/72h horizons.
